title: Walmart Cashier Learns Why Stealing from Work Never Pays: Cops
description:
When security at Walmart catches a cashier appearing to take cash from the register and put it in her pocket, her manager calls the police immediately. What followed next will prove a strong lesson for this Illinois woman, who seemingly lost her job after this incident and had more than just cash in her pockets. Dajah Hollie’s case is currently pending after she pleaded not guilty.
